title: Euro Style Wall Mount Toilet Paper Holder 7.5-Inch Solid Brass | Camo Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Organize your bathroom with a rugged, outdoor-inspired look using this 7.5-inch European style wall mount toilet paper holder. Part of the Camo collection, this fixture blends industrial pipe design with a unique camouflage finish for a sophisticated yet adventurous bathroom aesthetic.

  • Durable Solid Brass: Crafted from high-quality metal to provide a corrosion-free and rust-free finish that lasts.
  • Effortless Roll Changes: The open-ended European design allows you to slide rolls on and off without the hassle of a spring-loaded roller.
  • Industrial Farmhouse Aesthetic: Features distinctive pipe fittings that complement both rustic and transitional decor styles.
  • Space-Saving Installation: Wall-mounted design frees up floor space and mounts firmly with included color-coordinated screws.
  • Coordinated Design: Perfectly matches other pieces in the Allied Brass Camo collection for a complete bathroom transformation.

Specifications:
- Dimensions: 7.5-In L x 3-In H x 3.6-In W
- Material: Solid Brass
- Finish: Military Camo
- Hardware: Included (#8 X 1 1/4" screws)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime

_previous.description: Bring in the outdoors with this unique camouflage toilet paper holder. We have created this unique product line for the outdoor enthusiast using our farmhouse style bathroom accessories. The camo pattern applied to this product is protected with lifetime materials to provide a decorative and clean finish. No wonder, this European style toilet tissue holder gives continual service for years without any trouble. The choice of superior materials makes this item free from corrosion and rust. Toilet paper holder mounts firmly with color coordinating screws and comes with a limited lifetime warranty.
